answer.rationale: Provisionally pursue a limited incumbent renewal because the 14-day expiry and 94% line loading leave no buffer for migration failure. Verify the incumbent’s demonstrated continuity and the low-cost vendor’s onboarding record before committing; the 18% savings mandate makes switching economically relevant, but an immediate primary cutover could increase delivery risk. A narrow renewal preserves continuity and time to validate a later cost-reduction move.
